hero.title: EdLight Academy
hero.subtitle: A full learning platform for Haitian students — structured courses, real national exam prep, and a daily trivia game, all with progress tracking that keeps you motivated. Free and bilingual.

pillars.title: One platform, four ways to learn
pillars.subtitle: EdLight Academy is more than video lessons. Learners move between courses, exam practice, trivia, and a progress system built to keep them going.

courses.title: Structured courses
courses.description: Video lessons organized by subject and level, aligned to the Haitian national curriculum and taught in French and Kreyòl.

exams.title: Mock exams
exams.description: Real past national exams — from 9e Année to the Baccalauréat and university entrance — each with detailed, worked corrections.

trivia.title: Trivia game
trivia.description: A fast, daily trivia game across 15 categories, from chemistry and math to Haitian history, proverbs, and culture.

progress.title: Progress & rewards
progress.description: Quizzes with instant feedback, XP, levels, daily streaks, achievement badges, and a weekly leaderboard to keep you motivated.

gamification.title: Learning that keeps you coming back
gamification.body: Every lesson, quiz, and trivia round earns XP. Streaks, badges, and a weekly leaderboard turn steady studying into something you actually look forward to.

xp.title: XP & levels
xp.description: Earn XP for every lesson, quiz, and trivia round, and level up as you go.

streaks.title: Daily streaks
streaks.description: Keep your streak alive with a little learning each day — 3 days, a week, a month, and beyond.

leaderboard.title: Weekly leaderboard
leaderboard.description: See how you rank against other learners across the platform each week.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.description: Unlock badges for milestones — from your first quiz to a full year of consistency.

subjects.title: Structured courses, built for the Haitian curriculum
subjects.subtitle: Designed with Haitian educators and delivered in French and Kreyòl, each subject is organized into levels so learners always know what comes next.
subjects.note: Every course is available in both French and Haitian Creole.

physics.title: Physics
physics.description: Motion, energy, and the laws of the world.

svt.title: Life & Earth sciences (SVT)
svt.description: Biology, the body, and the environment.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: English and Spanish for the national exams.

exams.title: Practice with real national exams
exams.subtitle: Our mock-exam library (examens blancs) covers the full Haitian path, using authentic past papers with detailed, step-by-step corrections.

ninthYear.title: 9e Année
ninthYear.description: Official 9th-grade fundamental exams with complete past papers and detailed corrections.

bac.title: Baccalauréat
bac.description: Terminale exams across every track — SVT, SMP, SES, Lettres, and Arts.

university.title: University entrance
university.description: Admission concours and university exams to prepare for higher education with confidence.

trivia.title: Trivia: quick, daily, addictive
trivia.body: A daily challenge of 10 questions worth bonus XP, plus 15 categories that mix core subjects with Haitian history, geography, and culture. Perfect for a two-minute study break.

studyPlan.title: Your personalized path to the bac
studyPlan.subtitle: EdLight Academy turns scattered studying into a plan — and shows you exactly how ready you are for exam day.

plan.title: Personalized study plan
plan.description: A tailored plan with spaced repetition that schedules reviews so knowledge actually sticks.

score.title: Weighted BAC score
score.description: Track your readiness with a score weighted by your track’s coefficients — SVT ×4, Chemistry ×3, and more.

dashboard.title: Progress dashboard
dashboard.description: See active courses, quizzes taken, average score, and your streak at a glance.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Five steps to start learning with EdLight Academy.

steps.account: Create a free account at academy.edlight.org.
steps.subject: Pick a subject and follow structured lessons in French and Kreyòl.
steps.test: Test yourself with quizzes, real past exams, and daily trivia.
steps.track: Track your progress with XP, streaks, and a weighted BAC score.
steps.exams: Walk into your national exams prepared and confident.

cta.title: Ready to unlock EdLight Academy?
cta.body: Start learning for free, bring the platform to your classroom, or sponsor new courses for Haitian learners.
